title: Bakers and cake lovers: have you used AI for inspiration?
excerpt: Whether you are a customer who has used AI to show a baker your dream cake, or a baker who has to up their game - or turn down – orders based on AI inspo, we want to hear from you
content_html:
AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT are now widely used – including for creative inspiration. We are keen to hear from people on what happens when AI meets a physical art: baking.

Whether you are a customer who has used AI to show a baker your dream cake, or a baker who has to up their game - or turn down – orders based on AI inspo, we want to hear from you. Has AI led to extraordinary creations, or almighty disasters? Tell us all about it below.

If you’re having trouble using the form click here. Read terms of service here and privacy policy here.
